children: GBank Financial Holdings released an investor presentation highlighting a $1.4 billion balance sheet, $131.4M Q2 SBA originations and strategic Gaming FinTech growth.
$1.4B in assets as of June 30, 2026; presentation outlines disciplined growth across commercial banking, SBA lending and Gaming FinTech.
Q2 SBA originations of $131.4M; top SBA 7(a) and hotel lender with nationwide activity across 42 states.
Gaming deposits $35.5M and credit-card transactions $84.2M in Q2 2026 via 32.99%-owned BankCard Services, supporting deposit and program growth.
Loan portfolio: total loans ~$1.0B, yield on loans 7.31% and adjusted non-performing assets 1.49% after removing guaranteed portions.
Product rollout plans: BoltBetz casino-floor deployment in Q4 2026 and Lucky Loads virtual prepaid Visa pilot Nov–Dec 2026, backed by GBank sponsor-bank infrastructure.
